name: Conversion Pixel and Tracking Tag Manager
author: TAGLAB

sections.description:
WP Tracking Tag Manager is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to simplify the management of marketing tags, tracking pixels, and data layer events.

Easily manage your tracking scripts, integrate conversion pixels, and enhance marketing analytics—all without coding.

Features

  • Global Tag Script Injection
  • WooCommerce Data Layer Events for Google Tag Manager
  • WordPress Pages Meta Data in the dataLayer for Google Tag Manager

Coming Soon

  • All common marketing conversion pixels (Meta, Google Ads, Bing, TikTok, Reddit)
  • Custom events for popular plug ins and conditional triggering
  • Server Side Tracking and Conversion API for Facebook and TikTok
  • GTM Consent Mode

Support

For support, visit our website at https://taglab.net or [http://taglab.net/contact-us/](contact us) through the WordPress support forum.

Please feel free to request new features and we will do our best to accomodate your requests. This plug in is still in it’s early releases. If you like our work, please rate the plug in as a sign of appreciation.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, select the downloaded ZIP file, and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, click Activate Plugin.
  5. Configure your settings by navigating to WP Tag Manager.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes! WP Tracking Tag Manager seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce to track key events like view-item-list, view-item, select-item, view-cart, begin-checkout, and purchases.

Is coding required to use this plugin?

No, the plugin provides a user-friendly interface to manage tracking codes without any coding knowledge.

Can I add custom tracking scripts?

Yes, you can add custom scripts for specific pages or events directly from the settings panel.
